_meta.description: COHERENCE judge golden set: faithfulness labels vs the source articles the judge actually saw (articles[]). NOTE: label_pass is NOT independent -- it mirrors judge_pass on every case; the independent-of-the-judge field is label_blind, on a subset. See scored_by_gate and label_pass below. Built to validate the COHERENCE subagent, whose pass/fail drives merge.py dropping reader-facing headlines.
_meta.data_source: 31 production COHERENCE subagent transcripts extracted read-only from the news-digest-claude docker volume on the prod server, plus the local verify_agent_sdk run. Each case: headline+summary the judge fact-checked (draft_selections.json) cross-referenced against the article corpus it read (articles_*.csv).
_meta.articles_field: The id/title/summary of each cited source article the judge saw (resolved from articles_*.csv). Fail cases whose article_ids did not resolve have empty articles[] -- that non-resolution is itself the faithfulness defect.
_meta.label_pass: Independent labeler verdict. true=headline faithful to cited sources; false=unfaithful. Labels audited by manually reading the full source articles for a 13-case sample (10 fails + 3 passes) plus all 8 heuristic-flagged borderline cases; the judge's verdict was correct in every audited case, so label_pass mirrors the verified judge verdict. NOT 381 independent deep reads -- see data_gap.
_meta.blind_method: Independent blind re-label of a 60-case subset (35 judge-fail + 25 judge-pass), deciding faithful/unfaithful from articles[] title+summary ONLY, without reading judge_pass/judge_reason. label_blind/label_blind_rationale carry the blind verdict; true fail-precision and false-pass sweep computed from these.
_meta.scored_by_gate: bin/eval-regression scores its L2 rates against label_blind ONLY (the 60 cases above). label_pass is carried for provenance and is NOT scored: it equals judge_pass on every case, so any statistic built from that pair is arithmetic, not evidence. label_blind is independent OF THE JUDGE'S VERDICT, not human ground truth -- blind_method does not record who produced the 60 labels. Adding a label_blind field to a case enrols it in the gate (it must be a JSON boolean; omit the field to record 'undecided'); removing one trips the blind_labeled_cases guard. NOT yet enrolled and worth revisiting: the 6 bespoke-rationale cases (48, 70, 105, 152, 295, 327), which got the most scrutiny in this fixture's history, carry no label_blind and so are unscored.
_meta.certification: Certified 2026-06-15: re-judged all 386 cases with the FIXED cited-sources-only COHERENCE prompt (.claude/agents/coherence.md, sonnet-4-6, blind to labels). Both original leaks (case 48 'Gemini 3.5 Flash', case 105 Boeing '-4%') now correctly FAIL. The blind re-judge surfaced 10 judge-vs-label flips, each adjudicated by an adversarial 3-lens audit (attribution/specifics/holistic, all unanimous): corrected 4 LABEL errors (152/295/327 were false-fails -> faithful; 70 false-pass -> unfaithful) and confirmed 6 single-sample JUDGE-noise cases (28/137/190 a lone sample leaked but the historical judge + 3-lens catch them; 280/297/299 a lone sample over-dropped) -- denoised verdict matches the historical judge on all six, so judge_pass is unchanged there. Result (as measured THEN, by the label_pass-scored identity metric that bin/eval-regression no longer uses): leak_count=0, agreement=1.0. LIMITATION: single-sample COHERENCE runs show ~1% leak/over-drop on subtle misattribution headlines (terrorism-vs-charges, who-struck-whom, counterfeit-vs-junk) -- a known judge limitation and a GEPA target, NOT introduced by the cited-sources-only fix.
